kill_fact: No kill_fact survives. The load-bearing FY2025 financials the value case rests on (record adjusted net income EUR 846m, ROE 19.1%, solvency 215%, economic value per share EUR 48 at +13.7% growth, dividend EUR 1.9) all verify VERBATIM against SCOR's own audited Q4-2025 press release (2026-03-04) -- so there is no number-truth failure and no stale-anchor: the cheapness is computed off the current, not a pre-event, base. The bear's two would-be kill tails both fail on primary check: (1) the Covea retrocession arbitration is DIRECTIONALLY MISFRAMED -- SCOR is the CLAIMANT seeking EXECUTION of the June-2021 treaties (not a defendant facing a ~$1bn adverse award), and SCOR states all major arbitrations are 'provisioned at best estimate in SCOR's audited financial statements,' so it is a reserved, two-sided binary, not an un-provisioned off-balance-sheet bomb; (2) the criminal examination is a real but contestable governance overhang (PartnerRe-deal destabilization allegations), which SCOR contests and says does not impair normal operations -- an overhang, not a disqualifier.
corrections: (a) The bear's Covea framing ('adverse ~$1bn award is a one-off hit to capital management refuses to discuss') overstates the downside: SCOR is the claimant seeking enforcement, and the exposure is already provisioned at best estimate per the audited accounts -- correct the tail from 'un-reserved $1bn capital bomb' to 'reserved two-sided binary.' (b) The criminal examination is dated more precisely: the judicial investigation opened June 2022, but SCOR (the legal entity) was placed under formal examination in April 2025 over the alleged destabilization of Covea's PartnerRe acquisition (acts attributed to the late Denis Kessler / an associated association), which SCOR contests. (c) The bear's STRONGEST point survives and is the binding cap: the operating re-rate is largely spent -- spot ~EUR 28.7-29 (52wk EUR 25.30-33.48), consensus ~EUR 34 (~13% upside), Fitch Positive already public -- so residual upside is slow EV-convergence, not asymmetry, and the EPV/DCF +80/+84% MoS partly capitalizes a peak-cycle 2025 combined ratio that normalizes toward 87% as the P&C market softens (revenue already -5.4% YoY).
evidence: SCOR Fourth Quarter 2025 Results press release (scor.com, 2026-03-04): FY2025 adjusted net income EUR 846m / reported EUR 851m, adjusted ROE 19.1%, solvency 215% (within 185-220% optimal range), group economic value EUR 8.5bn (+13.7% at constant economics), economic value per share EUR 48, proposed dividend EUR 1.9 (+5.6%).

SCOR press release 'The timeline of the 2022 arbitration relating to retrocession treaties remains unchanged' (scor.com / GlobeNewswire, 2025-08-13): SCOR is CLAIMANT seeking execution of June-2021 Covea retrocession treaties; Covea's end-July-2025 stay request was opposed by SCOR and the tribunal maintained the original timeline (decision during 2026); 'all major arbitrations and disputes in which SCOR is involved are provisioned at best estimate in SCOR's audited financial statements.'

La Tribune de l'Assurance / Boursorama / Atlas Magazine (2025-04-04): SCOR placed under judicial examination as a legal entity (investigation opened June 2022) over alleged destabilization of Covea's PartnerRe acquisition attributed to former chairman Denis Kessler; SCOR contests any direct or indirect involvement and states no impact on its ability to operate in the normal course.

Analyst consensus (MarketScreener / chartmill, 2026): average target ~EUR 34 vs spot ~EUR 28.7-29, ~13% upside, consensus Moderate Buy (4 buy / 3 hold / 0 sell); 52-week range EUR 25.30-33.48 (Investing.com) -- confirming the re-rate is largely consensus-priced, capping idiosyncratic edge.
